title: T9 — Benefits diagram (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Benefits Diagram — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Goals and outcomes

- **Phases pass in order.** An architecture project passes Preliminary and A–F only when each
  phase's mandatory artefacts are approved and its contract is live
  (`togaf_architecture_phases.rs::phases_a_to_f_pass_in_order`).
- **A missing artefact blocks its phase.** An unapproved artefact refuses the phase.
- **No design without a live contract.** A delivery project without one is refused at design
  (`togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs`).
- **One level, dated waivers.** A compliance review records exactly one level, and a waiver
  names its owner and review date (`architecture_compliance.rs`).
- **H produces one governed outcome.** A scope change produces a change register row; a
  systemic finding produces a kata with no change row; an unrecorded review refuses the gate.

## Measures

| Measure | Instrument | State |
|---|---|---|
| A–F phase order and refusal | `crates/api/tests/togaf_architecture_phases.rs` | proved |
| Design gate | `togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs` | proved |
| Compliance level and waiver | `architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver` | proved |
| H outcome | `togaf_h_change.rs` | proved |

## Benefits and sub-benefits

The capability is the programme's design-control surface: contracts bind before design, gates
refuse unapproved artefacts, compliance levels are single-valued and waivers are owned and
dated. Its sub-benefits: no design proceeds on a draft contract, no phase passes on a missing
artefact, and every deviation has an owner and a reassessment date.
